A standalone checker independently calculates finite recurrences and worst phases; it is corroborative only.

value.rationale: The exact marginal slope separates expansive nonsmooth bifurcations from contraction, with no contraction-based decay guarantee. The theorem resolves a natural sharp stability boundary: a continuum of two-cycle graphs collapses, and the worst-case long-time convergence is explicitly equivalent to bounded-type arithmetic. The exact finite-time error is a motivated stability/transient invariant not supplied by qualitative graph-existence statements.
